NEVER make a real network call or a billed call: every test and your own checks must stub the network. Do not git commit.

YOU MAY CREATE OR EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe2.py and tests/test_opening_truck_probe2.py (both new). Never edit storygame/, packages/, data/, docs/, bench/, .plans/, or any existing script or test (including scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe.py, which you import from). The preregistration you implement is .plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback/probe2-prereg.md: read it first, it holds the exact arm text and counts. Reference implementation to copy patterns from and import helpers from: scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe.py (_new_product_replay, _opening_request, _control_request, _arm_one, _scripted_jev, _offline_worker_environment, _canonical_hash, _diff, _jev_transport, _validate_live_guard, _record, _quota_row, run structure, CLI shape) and scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py (CallCounter, QuotaExceeded, CallCapExceeded, _send_narrator, _jsonable, _write_json). Read probe.py fully before writing.

BUILD scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe2.py with the same CLI: `(--dry | --smoke | --run) --out PATH [--max-calls N] [--confirm]`, default max-calls 105.
1. build_document(), offline, no network:
 a. Control narrator requests via the product-wired replay (as probe.py does) for TWO commands: 'head out to the truck' and 'go to the truck', each after the route 'open the drawer', 'feel in the gap'. Generalize the replay helper in probe2.py (do not edit probe.py): the scripted Jev answers boarding yes for a command naming the truck. For each command check the request contains 'Already done:', the raw command line '- <command>', and a SCENE line placing Kristin in the driver's seat; raise a clear error otherwise. If the narrator is not called on the boarding turn for 'go to the truck', make it called the way probe.py does for the first command.
 b. Arm 1 per command: the control user text with the single line '- <command>' removed (reuse probe._arm_one logic; assert nothing else changes).
 c. Arm 2 per command: arm 1 plus one new line inserted immediately after the SCENE line that contains "driver's seat": `- Kristin can reach anything inside Kristin's truck from where she sits.` Assert the diff against arm 1 is exactly that one added line.
 d. Opening arm O1: the shipped opening user text (as probe.py builds it) plus these four SCENE bullets inserted, in order, immediately after the line starting `- Kristin Schweitzer's objective is`: `- Kristin is in Michelle's kitchen, just inside the forced back door.` / `- The workstation stands in the kitchen. Its chair lies overturned beside it.` / `- Michelle is Kristin's best friend, and Kristin knows this house. It is far too quiet.` / `- The KMS initials on the drawer are fresh cuts: Kristin's own initials on Michelle's furniture. Kristin cannot explain them.` Assert the diff against the shipped opening is exactly those four added lines (the apostrophes must match the shipped text byte for byte; check what the shipped objective line uses).
 e. Record unified diffs for every arm and a document hash.
2. Part 1 plan (live Jev), 48 calls: phrasings with a {v} slot, in this order: 'head out to {v}', 'go out to {v}', 'go to {v}', 'get in {v}', 'climb into {v}', 'walk out to {v}', 'walk up to {v}', 'approach {v}', 'look at {v}', 'get out of {v}', 'head over to {v}', 'make for {v}'. Expected yes: the first six. Expected no: 'walk up to', 'approach', 'look at', 'get out of'. Unscored: the last two. Vehicles: vehicle_name "Kristin's truck" with command text 'the truck'; vehicle_name 'the van' with command text 'the van'. Arms: S = the shipped question exactly as storygame.runtime.jev_questions.boards_vehicle_payload builds it; R = the same payload shape with these replacement strings. R instructions: "Decide whether the command has the player go to the vehicle in order to get in it. Going to, going out to, or heading out to a vehicle means the player gets in. Getting in, climbing in, sitting in, or driving it also counts." R true: "The command has the player go to, go out to, head out to, get into, sit in, or drive the vehicle." R false: "The command only looks at, touches, or talks about the vehicle, or only walks up to it or stands beside it. It is not boarding if it leaves the vehicle." Build R with the same _noul_question helper form (type noul, instructions, criteria true/false) under the key boards_vehicle; the state sent is {"command": command, "vehicle": vehicle_name}. 12 phrasings x 2 vehicles x 2 arms x 1 sample = 48 rows, order interleaved S then R per cell. Record per row: arm, phrasing, command, vehicle_name, expected (yes/no/unscored), raw answer, is_yes via jev.noul_yes (None if unanswered), error. Live path: JevClient.from_environment().ask(state, questions) with the counter, exactly as probe._part1_row does for boards_vehicle (including 429 handling).
3. Part 2 plan (live narrator), 36 calls, interleaved, with variant labels: 'head out to the truck' arm 2 x 12; 'go to the truck' arms 0, 1, 2 x 8 each (24). Part 3: opening arm O1 x 10. Total 48 + 36 + 10 = 94. Cap check before the first call rejects a planned total over --max-calls (so --max-calls 93 is refused).
4. --dry writes the document and makes zero calls (print 'dry: document built, 94 planned calls, 0 calls'). --smoke (billed, needs --confirm) is exactly 5 calls: 3 Jev (arm R, truck: 'head out to the truck', 'go out to the truck', 'walk up to the truck'), 1 Part 2 (the first row), 1 Part 3 (the first row). --run (billed, needs --confirm) is all 94. Without --confirm any billed mode exits non-zero with no call. Refuse a billed mode when CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL is empty or the placeholder https://w.example. Stop immediately and keep partial rows on a 429, AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. No retries, no replacement samples. Write the result JSON after every call. Output: mode, document_hash, planned_calls, max_calls, calls_made, stop_reason, rows.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_opening_truck_probe2.py (hermetic; any real urlopen or socket reached fails the test; monkeypatch storygame.runtime.cloudflare.urlopen and the JevClient ask): arm 1 removes exactly one line per command; arm 2 adds exactly the reach line; O1 adds exactly four lines; plan totals 48/36/10/94 and --max-calls 93 is rejected; revised question text equals the strings above and differs from the shipped one only in those fields; billed modes without --confirm exit non-zero with zero calls; placeholder URL refused; a fake narrator and fake Jev drive a full --run to 94 rows with the expected interleaving and a None answer; a fake 429 stops and keeps partial rows; --smoke makes exactly 5 calls. DONE WHEN the check passes. Report which helpers you imported and anything you could not do.
